headline: Ugro Capital Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger — Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ) intimating NCLT order dated 06th August 2026…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger — Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ) intimating NCLT order dated 06th August 2026 directing the meeting of Equity Shareholders, Secured Creditors and Unsecured Creditors of the Company in connection with the Scheme of Amalgamation.
